catalog.summary: Trail of links to the current page's ancestors.

trigger.reason: A crumb that switches between siblings — organization, project, environment — opens a menu of them. A `link` is an `a`, and an `a` without `href` takes no focus, so the switching crumb is a `button` part of its own. The consumer composes `menu` around it; `current` keeps `aria-current="page"` on the page's own switcher, which the surveyed ReUI shell drops.

collapse.measurement: @slotted/core/overflow — `createCollapse` over the visible items, while the trail is collapsed and `overflow` is `collapse`
collapse.order: the middle crumbs fold from the one nearest the root to the one nearest the page, so the folded run stays next to the ellipsis; the `itemsBeforeCollapse` and `itemsAfterCollapse` crumbs never fold
collapse.degradation: a trail whose fixed crumbs alone exceed its width wraps, and the widest crumb truncates
collapse.expanded: an expanded trail does not fold: expanding was the reader's choice, and a narrower column wraps it instead
collapse.reports: `data-collapsed` on the root carries the count of hidden crumbs, and the ellipsis names the same count

keyboard.effect: moves to each link in the trail, and to the ellipsis when the trail is collapsed
expands a collapsed trail when the ellipsis has focus
keyboard.focus: the first revealed link, because the ellipsis stops existing

keyboard.effect: expands a collapsed trail when the ellipsis has focus
keyboard.focus: the first revealed link, because the ellipsis stops existing

skeleton.reason: A trail whose labels are still loading is a trail of skeletons, and skeleton already ships the shape. Two families drawing a loading placeholder would be two answers to one question.

size.reason: Carbon is the only surveyed implementation with a size step, and the three densities already restate the control scale. A second scale would contradict them at two of the three.

menu.reason: shadcn and MUI both put the collapsed crumbs in an overlay. This family expands them in place instead, which needs no layer, no positioner and no dismissal policy; a consumer who wants the overlay composes menu around the ellipsis in wave 5.

collapsedState.reason: What folded for want of width is read from the browser. A controlled pair over it would let a consumer assert that a trail fits when the layout says it does not; `toolbar` declines the same pair for the same reason. The count is in the DOM instead.

disabled.reason: React Aria alone disables a crumb. A crumb that leads nowhere is a `page` part, which the family already ships, and a disabled link in a trail is an ancestor the reader is told about and cannot reach.

literals.--slotted-breadcrumb-separator-skew: The angle a one-pixel rule is rotated through to read as a slash. It is a shape rather than a step on a scale, and docs/token-foundation.md holds no scale of angles.
